nodes.title: Learning's D11 (relayed by main): fraction-bars@1 takes an UNNAMED bar, label "". It draws no name, its facts row says "<parts> equal parts" (no shaded count or value), and the label-value check skips it; a named bar is still checked. A compare card ("2/3 ya 3/10?") can now be posed honestly. Before, an unshaded bar could only say "?" (over a fraction the prompt states: director16 c5-t02 steady 70–92) or be named, which shades it and answers the card. The second view treats "" like "?": unnamed bars become circles (S8) and name no fraction. Under the held board an unnamed-bars card stands in the split's left panel. Pinned in tests/r8-held-board.test.mjs.
